vv51:1.1: Ko me vandati pādāni iddhiyā yasasā jalaṃ abhikkantena vaṇṇena sabbā obhāsayaṃ disā ti. || ||
vv51:2.1: Maṇḍūko 'haṃ pure āsiṃ udake vārigocaro tava dhammaṃ suṇantassa avadhī vacchapālako. || ||
vv51:3.1: Muhuttaṃ cittappasādassa iddhiṃ passa yasañ ca me ānubhāvañ ca me passa vaṇṇaṃ passa jutiñ ca me: || ||
vv51:4.1: Ye ca te dīgham addhānaṃ dhammaṃ assosuṃ Gotama pattā te acalaṭṭhānaṃ yattha gantvā na socare ti. || ||
